set.body:
Objective

Adopt the scalar evidence pairing as the constitutional second-order algebra of effectagram:

E_LR(H, K) = <H, B_L K B_R^T>_F = <B_L^T H B_R, K>_F.

Closing the neural boundary yields an effect_form. Closing the experimental boundary yields a measurement_form. Closing both yields scalar evidence. These remain distinct semantic results produced from one private contraction-plan IR.

Architecture

left relation + right relation + ordered partition pipeline
  -> typed experimental and neural boundaries
  -> axis-labelled normalization, transformation, and reduction
  -> effect_form | measurement_form | scalar_field

A single semantic IR may select multiple independently certified physical lowerings. The Kronecker lift B_R tensor B_L is conceptual and must never be materialized by default.

Stages

1. Freeze evidence-pairing semantics and independent oracle laws.
2. Generalize the private task IR while preserving the certified effect-form specialization.
3. Add identified measurement legs, frames, edges, and direct-sum decompositions.
4. Implement dense and optimized measurement-form contraction lowerings.
5. Add measurement-form results, storage, receipts, and capability semantics.
6. Lift node decompositions onto edge blocks, beginning with coherent/configuration.
7. Add scientifically gated effect, covariance, canonical, alignment, and information views.
8. Add dual-frame reconstruction with exact, projected, and ill-conditioned diagnostics.
9. Expose the narrow public API and executable user documentation.
10. Run independent semantic, numerical, resource, compatibility, installed-artifact, and R CMD check certification.

Program acceptance

- Existing geometry(), effect_form, packed storage, queries, plan identities, and installed workflows remain exact compatibility specializations.
- Adjoint, vectorization, partial-application, reversal, direct-sum, decomposition, and dual-frame laws pass against independent oracles.
- Every optimized lowering agrees with the dense oracle under the numerical contract.
- Structural guarantees are capabilities; sample-dependent rank, conditioning, and eigenvalue observations remain diagnostics.
- Rank-one effect coupling is valid but cannot be mislabeled as nondegenerate normalized connectivity.
- Correlation and normalization identify their axis and cannot cross nonlinear or partition-reduction stages silently.
- Complete frame blocks reconstruct the global neural evidence operator only when injectivity and conditioning requirements are met.
- No searchlight-all-pairs computation, Kronecker materialization, covariance claim, or causal claim occurs implicitly.
- The installed package passes the full test court and CRAN-like package check.

Ownership boundaries

The fixed-bilinear core owns relations, typed boundaries, contraction planning, form materialization, identities, and receipts. Learned transforms must be trained externally and enter only as frozen identified legs. Inference, calibration, causal modeling, and dynamic informational-connectivity learners remain adjacent layers.

Deferred non-goals

No connectivity delivery in version 0.1; no method registry; no arbitrary local callback; no implicit all-to-all searchlight graph; no learned local covariance inside the fixed core; no normalization of indefinite crossvalidated forms into correlations; no claim that all fMRI analyses reduce to this algebra; and no two-sided experimental tomography until neural reconstruction is certified.

Completion

This epic closes only after every staged child is closed and the final independent certification child proves the complete contract against current source, tests, documentation, benchmarks, installed artifacts, and R CMD check.
set.title: Epic: Unify effect geometry and coupling through evidence pairing
